verses.t: “Upāsitā sappurisā, sutā dhammā abhiṇhaso; Sutvāna paṭipajjissaṁ, añjasaṁ amatogadhaṁ.
Bhavarāgahatassa me sato, Bhavarāgo puna me na vijjati; Na cāhu na ca me bhavissati, Na ca me etarahi vijjatī”ti. … Kaṇhadinno thero … vaggo tatiyo.
Uttaro bhaddajitthero, sobhito valliyo isi; Vītasoko ca yo thero, puṇṇamāso ca nandako; Bharato bhāradvājo ca, kaṇhadinno mahāmunīti.
